function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values (i.e., 48 patients appear more than once in the dataset), and `sample_seq` indicates that some patients were re-tested (with multiple rows per patient).", "implication": "The dataset contains multiple rows per patient. To ensure one row per patient in the analysis, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient. Failure to do so would overcount patients and bias the response rate calculation, especially since re-tested patients are not a random subset — they may be sicker or have other systematic differences. This directly affects the population and must be handled before computing response rates by site."}
function.name: note_finding
